rationale: NOW has gapped down ~19.5% on earnings with extremely elevated relative volume (14.4x), and price is currently sitting at 23% of today's range near the session low after a failed bounce attempt — the last 5 candles show a drift lower from ~115 toward ~114.50 with no clear stabilization. The mixed earnings reaction (revenue beat but EPS miss, Zacks Sell rating) creates genuine two-way uncertainty: a long risks further selling into the gap, while a short risks a sharp mean-reversion squeeze given the stock is already deeply oversold intraday. With no clear directional edge and significant gap-day volatility, the risk/reward is insufficient to justify a new position alongside existing committed capital.
